Let's sketch the trajectory.

- We start at the given point, going along with the flow (upward and slightly to the right) until the trajectory intersects the $x$-nullcline, where the tangents are vertical.

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/question-capture-workers/differential/14068646/assets/6d897c2e9249447cc2d0c902a592d04442b0928c315163b6ab80cff288c84657.png)

- Next, the flow continues going upward but then starts turning  to the left.

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/question-capture-workers/differential/14068646/assets/bed6896ecc0edcdb157b648108d403e1b8e29463d9f61aa0e0c26e8f5e2dd8c6.png)

- After that, the trajectory continues upward and slightly to the left, suggesting that it may converge to the origin

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/question-capture-workers/differential/14068646/assets/cc53577a278595e5f0155119aa5eb1a7b27ec01847a6daa1ba6ade6792c5f5e9.png)
html:
Let's sketch the trajectory.

  • We start at the given point, going along with the flow (upward and slightly to the right) until the trajectory intersects the x-nullcline, where the tangents are vertical.
  • Next, the flow continues going upward but then starts turning to the left.
  • After that, the trajectory continues upward and slightly to the left, suggesting that it may converge to the origin
